description: This file defines a React component 'TargetRoleDetailsPanel' that displays details of a selected target role, including information like title, industry, description, score, tags, skills, responsibilities, and related reports. It also includes utility functions for processing persona skills and other data transformations.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null/undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Safely converts an unknown value to an array of strings, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Transforms an array of strings into sanitized, uniformly formatted bulleted sentences.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a numeric value to the 0-100 range, rounding to the nearest integer.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts and deduplicates skills from a persona object, considering multiple nested fields.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Normalizes a skill string for comparison by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds matching skills present in both persona skills and required skills.
